errors.name: ArtistArchiveInvalidBinding
errors.natspec: @notice The immutable Registry or Coordinator binding is zero.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveUnauthorizedWriter
errors.natspec:
@notice A caller other than the immutable Coordinator attempted to append evidence.
 @dev This is a transport-integrity gate only and is not semantic authorization.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveInvalidEvidenceKey
errors.natspec: @notice The exact evidence key uses a zero id or zero version.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveEmptyEvidence
errors.natspec: @notice Evidence bytes must not be empty.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveEvidenceTooLarge
errors.natspec: @notice Evidence bytes exceed the immutable archive payload bound.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveBlockNumberOverflow
errors.natspec: @notice The append block cannot be represented by the frozen receipt schema.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveEvidenceConflict
errors.natspec: @notice Different evidence bytes already occupy the exact id/version key.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveEvidenceUnavailable
errors.natspec: @notice No evidence has been appended at the exact id/version key.

errors.name: ArtistArchiveEvidenceCorrupted
errors.natspec: @notice The immutable payload bytes no longer match their append receipt.

events.name: ArtistArchiveEvidenceAppendedV2
events.natspec:
@notice Evidence-only receipt for the first append at an exact id/version key.
 @dev This event is non-normative and cannot substitute for an owner-domain event.

functions.name: appendArtistEvidenceV2
artistEvidenceMetadataV2
functions.natspec:
@notice Reads metadata for one exact evidence id/version.
 @dev No enumeration, count, tip, current, or latest surface is exposed.

functions.name: artistEvidenceBytesV2
functions.natspec: @notice Reads immutable bytes for one exact evidence id/version.

definition.name: IStreamArtistArchiveV2
